basic_details.job_title: DMMU Birbhum Community Resource Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Office of the District Mission Management Unit (DMMU) & District Rural Development Cell, Birbhum, West Bengal, has invited applications for 14 posts of Community Resource Person (CRP) under Advt No. 3544/IX-63/DMMU/Birbhum. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 17 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Passed Higher Secondary Examination or equivalent 12th-standard examination, with at least 3 years' working experience as CRP, Meen Mitra, Van Sakhi, PMK or other community cadre under NRLM; women members of NRLM SHGs only
qualification.details: Qualification: Higher Secondary Examination or equivalent 12th-standard examination passed; at least 3 years' working experience as CRPs, Meen Mitras, Van Sakhis, PMKs or other community cadres under NRLM Experience: At least three (3) years working experience as CRPs, Meen Mitras, Van Sakhis, PMKs, or other community cadres under the NRLM project, certified by the concerned BDO Age limit: 25 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) | Other conditions: | Only women members of NRLM Self-Help Groups may apply Must be a resident of Birbhum district Must be a valid elector with her name in the current electoral roll Should be willing to work in any MKSP-IFC project under Birbhum District whenever required Should be willing to attend any training or workshop within and outside the State whenever required If selected, must resign from any post as worker of Government Organization/NGO/ICDS/ASHA/VRP/PRI member/PRI Office Bearer

salary_details.pay_scale: Entitlement as per the existing order of WBSRLM; no amount printed

pattern_table.Subject: Math, English, G.K, NRLM-related topics, basic computer knowledge (10th-standard syllabus)

exam_pattern.details: Written test consists of multiple-choice questions (MCQs), 2 marks each

how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form from http://birbhum.gov.in, any Block Office in Birbhum (NRLM Section) or the ADMD, DMMU & PD, DRDC office, Suri.
Fill in the prescribed form; applications only in this form are accepted.
Attach copies of proof of age, residence, qualification and the BDO's 3-year experience certificate.
Submit at the Office of the ADMD, DMMU and PD, DRDC, 1st Floor, Suri, Birbhum, in the drop box.
Submit between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on any working day from 29-10-2026 to 17-11-2026.
important_instructions: No T.A / DA will be paid for appearing in the Written Test and Interview Misinformation, wrong information or malpractice leads to summary cancellation of candidature at any point during the project period Candidature of anyone who does not appear for the interview will be cancelled Applications are accepted only in the prescribed form

content_sections.text: Last date: 17 November 2026 Vacancies: 14 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: All candidates: No application fee Pay: Entitlement as per the existing order of WBSRLM; no amount printed Age limit: 25 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Places: Bolpur-Sriniketan Block: Raipur-Supur (2), Sarpalehana-Albandha (3), Labpur Block: Chauhatta Mahodari-I (2), Suri-I Block: Nagari (1), Sainthia Block: Amarpur (1), Sangra (1), Nanoor Block: Kirnahar-II (1), Nalhati-I Block: Paikpara (1), Kalitha (1); Mayureswar-II Block: Dheka (1)

content_sections.heading: DMMU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 3544/IX-63/DMMU/Birbhum gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DMMU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Higher Secondary Examination or equivalent 12th-standard examination passed; at least 3 years' working experience as CRPs, Meen Mitras, Van Sakhis, PMKs or other community cadres under NRLM Experience: At least three (3) years working experience as CRPs, Meen Mitras, Van Sakhis, PMKs, or other community cadres under the NRLM project, certified by the concerned BDO Age limit: 25 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Only women members of NRLM Self-Help Groups may apply Must be a resident of Birbhum district Must be a valid elector with her name in the current electoral roll Should be willing to work in any MKSP-IFC project under Birbhum District whenever required Should be willing to attend any training or workshop within and outside the State whenever required If selected, must resign from any post as worker of Government Organization/NGO/ICDS/ASHA/VRP/PRI member/PRI Office Bearer

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Entitlement as per the existing order of WBSRLM; no amount is printed. Project period of 3 years subject to availability of MKSP funds (as per guideline of NRLM) May be deployed to any IFC unit under the MKSP-IFC project in any Block within Birbhum district CRP will report to the BDO of the concerned Block

rows.event: Starting Date of Submission of Application

content_sections.heading: How Will DMMU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Test (90 marks) Interview (10 marks) Written test of 45 MCQs, 2 marks each, total 90 marks, duration 1 hour 30 minutes Written test based on 10th-standard syllabus: Math, English, G.K, NRLM-related topics and basic computer knowledge Candidates who qualify in the written test will be called for an interview of 10 marks

content_sections.heading: DMMU Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Written test consists of multiple-choice questions (MCQs), 2 marks each

rows.subject: Math, English, G.K, NRLM-related topics, basic computer knowledge (10th-standard syllabus)

content_sections.text: Birth Certificate or Madhyamik/equivalent Admit Card for proof of age Aadhaar or EPIC for proof of residence Examination Marksheet or Certificate (Higher Secondary or equivalent) for proof of educational qualification 3 years' Experience Certificate of working in NRLM from the concerned BDO

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMMU Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from http://birbhum.gov.in, any Block Office in Birbhum (NRLM Section) or the ADMD, DMMU & PD, DRDC office, Suri. Fill in the prescribed form; applications only in this form are accepted. Attach copies of proof of age, residence, qualification and the BDO's 3-year experience certificate. Submit at the Office of the ADMD, DMMU and PD, DRDC, 1st Floor, Suri, Birbhum, in the drop box. Submit between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on any working day from 29-10-2026 to 17-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No T.A / DA will be paid for appearing in the Written Test and Interview Misinformation, wrong information or malpractice leads to summary cancellation of candidature at any point during the project period Candidature of anyone who does not appear for the interview will be cancelled Applications are accepted only in the prescribed form

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DMMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DMMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies for Community Resource Person (CRP).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DMMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed form attached with the notice; available on http://birbhum.gov.in, at all Block Offices in Birbhum (NRLM Section) and at the office of the ADMD, DMMU & PD, DRDC, Suri) and send it to Office of the Additional District Mission Director, DMMU and PD, DRDC, DRDC Office, 1st Floor, Suri, Birbhum (in the drop box), by submitted at the office in the drop box (11:00 am to 5:00 pm on working days), to reach by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: No application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 25 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Entitlement as per the existing order of WBSRLM; no amount printed.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Passed Higher Secondary Examination or equivalent 12th-standard examination, with at least 3 years' working experience as CRP, Meen Mitra, Van Sakhi, PMK or other community cadre under NRLM; women members of NRLM SHGs only.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women members of NRLM Self-Help Groups may apply. Must be a resident of Birbhum district. Must be a valid elector with her name in the current electoral roll. Should be willing to work in any MKSP-IFC project under Birbhum District whenever required.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Test (90 marks). Interview (10 marks). Written test of 45 MCQs, 2 marks each, total 90 marks, duration 1 hour 30 minutes. Written test based on 10th-standard syllabus: Math, English, G.K, NRLM-related topics and basic computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Project period of 3 years subject to availability of MKSP funds (as per guideline of NRLM). May be deployed to any IFC unit under the MKSP-IFC project in any Block within Birbhum district. CRP will report to the BDO of the concerned Block.
